hypothesis: A fresh zero-capability AppContainer token launch, unlike per-image firewall rules, can retain the same restricted SID and no network capabilities in a differently imaged child. This limited canary tests the launch mechanism, not Native admission.
specific_blocker: Windows005/006 cannot establish descendant/profile-independent denial through per-image firewall rule observations. Existing Native gate remains unchanged and refused.
comparison: Positive host IPv4 TCP loopback and one frozen api.github.com IPv4:443 before and after; parent and differently compiled child must each report actual token SID/capability count and explicit WSAEACCES10013 for both endpoints. Unknown/timeout/unreachable is never denial.

execution.followup_policy: At most one causally justified correction after retained first failure. No repeat/endpoint search/installer loop, gate weakening or Native admission.

shared_controls: One private Job Object lifecycle for probe, compiler and DNS setup; create suspended, assign no-breakaway/kill-on-close, limit2GiB,256KiB log,128MiB scratch,4000 entries, full exited-member CPU, terminate/wait zero members and checked handle cleanup. Setup allowlist permits only fixed source roles and isolated DNS helper; it claims no network isolation.
prerequisites: Preinstalled MSVC/SDK observed/pinned before execution; fixed source /MT x64 role1/2 images must differ. Setup DNS5seconds, each compile30seconds; setup included as additional authoring cost, not routing time.
cleanup_acceptance: Exact owned DACL bytes/protection restored; all owned Jobs reaped; exact fresh profile Delete S_OK and owned profile storage folder absent. Registry absence is explicitly unqueried; files retained in ephemeral scope until runner disposal. Any missing proof is failure/unknown.
decision: Integrate the small launch adapter only as an experimental canary if all observations pass. Native compatibility, all-network/future-profile guarantees, write confinement, full tool manifests and actual export/route/refill/validate/cancel/export remain separate unmet gates. Otherwise revise once if bounded and causal, then defer.
not_claimed: scratch-write or broader source protection qualification

local_checks.claim: Pure source/real-file controls only; PowerShell absent; no Windows APIs/C build/CI executed.

review.shared_lifecycle_setup: windows005_gate found old loop extraction and exceptional log-loss; root fixed both, added actual-function regression. No other concrete lifecycle/admission defect found.

review.cost: Authoring/model/review/primary browsing not completely instrumented, additional and unknown, not zero. No speed claim.

hosted_preflight.zero_cost_basis: Current official sources: public repository standard windows-2022 compute is free; no artifact/cache/custom-image creation or downloads/installers in this job. Logs do not count toward artifact storage.
